headline: Quantum Control and Stochastic Volatility Methods
summary: Today's research features a diverse collection spanning quantum information theory, entanglement recovery, and stochastic volatility pricing. The papers advance both foundational quantum mechanics and practical computational engines for complex financial models.

themes.title: Quantum Information and Tomography
themes.body: Explores optimal testing of Lindbladian dissipation, parallel query unitary channel tomography, entanglement recovery certificates, and the exact strong converse exponent for private communication.

themes.title: Quantum Error Correction
themes.body: Introduces a local and distributed decoding framework utilizing autonomous feedback and belief propagation for quantum LDPC codes.

themes.title: Stochastic Volatility Pricing
themes.body: Develops a non-perturbative Dyson-Schwinger effective-action framework for rough volatility, leveraging quantum field theory tools for deterministic option pricing engines.
